decisions.decision: Conjunction of the principals perfects unless prohibition or refranation (or frustration, B04) precedes it; angle/first house, succedent and cadent qualify ease and speed only.
Sextile/trine needs good houses, essential dignity and no malevolent aspect intervening before partile; the qualities are qualitative evidence.
Square needs dignity in the degrees of each planet and application out of proper and good houses; otherwise not.

Opposition needs mutual house reception, friendly houses and the Moon separating from the quesited significator and applying presently to the Lord of the Ascendant; completion and regret are separate results.
Structural translation (p.111): a lighter planet separates from one principal and applies to the other; no reception or principal-history condition.

Full translation (p.126): principals separated from conjunction/sextile/trine; translator received by the principal it leaves by house, triplicity or term; no contact with another planet before the second leg. No default between P05 and P06.
Collection: non-beholding principals each apply to a heavier collector that each receives by some essential dignity. Non-beholding has two named readings: sign_aversion and no_current_aspect.
Mutual reception of the principals is its own route; it never cancels a blocker on another route and no aggregation is admitted.
Dwelling in houses alone is reported as the Ancients' rule rejected by Lilly; the only positive form adds the Moon translating the quesited significator's light to the Lord of the Ascendant.
Bodily prohibition; readings interposition_to_either and successive_to_both, no default. Stated effect: hindered and retarded.
Prohibition by aspect; same readings as B01. A third planet already separating from the applying principal is a translation candidate, not a prohibitor.

Refranation is the applying planet stationing retrograde within an established application before exactitude; no later exact contact is required. A station of the heavier principal is not refranation. Stated effect: never effected.
Frustration is conjunction-specific: the heavier principal conjoins a third before the lighter reaches it. Stated effect: a third party gains.
Malevolent intervention has readings malefic_planet (aspect from Saturn or Mars) and hard_aspect (square or opposition from any planet); applies to P02 only.
A blocker counts only when its envelope ends before the blocked contact's envelope begins; overlap is unresolved; no one-second constant.
A route completes only when every leg completes in order; collection leg order is reported, not required.
Every candidate route and blocker is kept; no first-candidate truncation.
No precedence or aggregation across routes; the earliest completing route is a reported fact, not a verdict.
Sign ingress is recorded, not treated as a blocker; its effect is a separately selectable policy.
Absence needs complete coverage up to the completing contact; partial coverage gives unresolved, never negative.
Continuation carries open legs and unresolved envelopes across search windows; a route cannot complete from discarded state.
Heaviness readings traditional_order, instantaneous_speed and superior_inferior, selected per mechanism, no default.
Condition epochs (question, leg start, completing contact) are explicit; a value known at one epoch is not transported to another.
Good, proper and friendly houses, essential well-dignity, swiftness and accidental strength are bound qualitative evidence; no score or house list supplied by Moira establishes them.
The opposition route's Moon condition is read from the P3 lunar sequence and coverage; "presently" has no numerical meaning.
Timing statements are qualitative qualifiers; no degree-to-time-unit conversion is admitted.

source_claims.paraphrase: Degrees still needed for full separation give weeks, days, months or years; movable/angular/swift hasten, common longer, fixed longest.
Another planet interposes body or aspect before two applying significators perfect; the matter is hindered and retarded.
Sun 6 Aries overtakes Mars 7 Aries and conjoins Saturn 12 Aries first, impeding Mars then Saturn.
Sun 5 Gemini passes the dexter sextile of Mars 7 Aries and reaches a dexter sextile of Saturn before Mars reaches Saturn.
Mars 7 Aries hastens to Saturn 12 Aries but turns retrograde before the tenth or eleventh degree; nothing signified will ever be effected.
Mercury 16 Aries separates from Mars 15 Aries and translates his virtue to Saturn 20 Aries; any aspect also serves.
Mutual reception by house is strongest; it brings the matter to pass when aspects deny it, are absent or doubtful.
Mercury 10 Aries would conjoin Mars 12 Aries, but Mars first conjoins Jupiter 13 Aries; two dogs quarrel, a third gets the bone.
Saturn, Jupiter and Mars are superior and more weighty; Venus, Mercury and Moon inferior.

Conjunction qualified by house class; sextile/trine by good houses, dignity and no malevolent aspect; square by dignity in the degrees and good houses, otherwise not; opposition only with three conditions and with regret.
Principals separated from conjunction/sextile/trine; translator received by house, triplicity or term from the principal it leaves; applies to the other before meeting any other planet.
Principals do not behold one another; both aspect a more weighty planet whom both receive in some essential dignity.
The quesited significator in the Ascendant is the Ancients' rule, rejected unless the Moon also transfers its light to the Lord of the Ascendant.
